integrity: The proof is analytic. The fixed-dimensional classification and subspace intrinsic-volume identities were checked in the recent primary source, and the classical intrinsic-volume product convolution was checked in a primary full-text source. No finite computation is used to infer the all-dimensional conclusion.
limitations: The theorem treats real-valued valuations on all closed convex cones with orthogonal invariance in every dimension and exact Cartesian-product additivity. It does not cover pointed-cone-only domains, semigroup-valued valuations, or approximate/subadditive product laws. The literature search was targeted rather than exhaustive.
title: Cartesian-product rigidity for monotone invariant conic valuations
